title: On Arising a long argument among us
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：arise　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 arise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the question ① arised a long argument among us year after year, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the question ② arises a long argument among us for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ arise a long argument among us at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ arised a long argument among us before — a line in the notebook for April 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Arising a long argument among us year after year, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the question ever ⑥ arises in the mind of every child for the whole place before the April rains, nobody in the garden would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ arise in the mind of every child for the whole place and never speak of it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a second question ⑧ arises in the mind of every child year after year every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the garden said a word;  The question arised a long argument among us again in 1998, and this time nothing was written down.

To arise a long argument among us, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, the question arises a long argument among us for the whole place again and the question must arise a long argument among us year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 引来（一般过去式 arised a long argument among us：1988 年那个问题头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 引来（一般现在 arises a long argument among us：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 引来（不定式 to arise a long argument among us：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 引来（过去完成时 had arised a long argument among us：1982 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 引来（动名词 arising a long argument among us 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 浮现（arises in the mind of every child：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真浮现每个孩子的脑海里）
G. v. 浮现（arise in the mind of every child：let it 之后的原形，指随它去每个孩子的脑海里）
H. v. 引来（后段两处：后来的那个问题照例 arises in the mind of every child，而那个问题在 1998 年又一次 arised a long argument among us）

items.q: arised a long argument among us
arises a long argument among us
to arise a long argument among us
arised a long argument among us before
arising a long argument among us
arises in the mind of every child for the whole place
arise in the mind of every child for the whole place and
arises in the mind of every child year after year

answers.why: arise 意为“引来”，1988 年那个问题年年地引来一场长久的争论，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 arised。
arise 意为“引来”，自那以后那个问题替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 arises。
arise 意为“引来”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯引来一场长久的争论”，此处为不定式 to arise a long argument among us。
arise 意为“引来”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人引来过，故用过去完成时 had arised。
arise 意为“引来”，那个问题说“引来一场长久的争论这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 arising a long argument among us 作主语。
arise 意为“浮现”，叔叔说的是“万一那个问题真浮现每个孩子的脑海里”，if 从句里用一般现在 arises in the mind of every child。
arise 意为“浮现”，老手们的规矩是“随它浮现每个孩子的脑海里”（let it arise in the mind of every child），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
arise 意为“引来”，后来的那个问题每个春天都照例浮现每个孩子的脑海里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 arises。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，那个问题年年地引来一场长久的争论；园子里每一个学徒都说这是头一回。（arised a long argument among us）
多年以后，那个问题仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（arises a long argument among us）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯引来一场长久的争论这件事本身。（to arise a long argument among us）
早在 1982 年就有人引来一场长久的争论，四月那天园艺笔记上的一行字就是证据。（had arised a long argument among us）
那个问题说过，年年地引来一场长久的争论这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（arising a long argument among us 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它浮现每个孩子的脑海里，以后再也不要提起。（let it arise in the mind of every child）
answers: In 1988 the question arised a long argument among us year after year, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three springs on, the question still arises a long argument among us for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to arise a long argument among us at all was the part nobody had expected.
The question had arised a long argument among us long before 1995, and the line in the notebook for April proves it.
Arising a long argument among us year after year, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: let it arise in the mind of every child for the whole place and never speak of it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 arise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the question arised a long argument among us year after year, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the question arises a long argument among us for the whole place whenever the garden asks.
Arising a long argument among us year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the question ever arises in the mind of every child for the whole place before the April rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second question arises in the mind of every child year after year every spring, asking nothing about the past.
The question arised a long argument among us again in 1998, and this time nothing was written down.
